bullets.title: Wind River
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Wind-River-Jeremy-Renner/dp/B0747CZ514), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1MXHP4UaYHY)), written and directed by the incredible [Taylor Sheridan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Sheridan), co-creator of _Yellowstone_. This is an excellent but very dark movie. It received a lengthy eight-minute standing ovation at the end of its premiere in the Un Certain Regard competition of the Cannes film festival. Description: “A chilling murder mystery set in the icy backwoods of a Native American Reservation, starring [Elizabeth Olsen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elizabeth_Olsen) and [Jeremy Renner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeremy_Renner) ([@JeremyRenner](https://twitter.com/JeremyRenner)).” You can [find the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s7WuKdVhrmA). Not suitable for family viewing.
